description:
From: GC. Approved by the user 2026-11-24 with the fz-9x7.49 page (verbatim "approved;", https://claude.ai/artifact/9yNjH7q4xZFuFVwNnRpYhr, 'Proposed ticket' bullet).

Today: binaries_shared is a heap field bumped inline through fn_ctx::bump_process_counter (fn_ctx.rs:279) and printed on the process exit line. After fz-9x7.49 it is the last per-process inline counter.

Change: count it at a site in the per-program site table (as .37.3 did for allocations and .49 for reuse), report the sum, delete the heap field, its offset, the exit-line field and bump_process_counter.

Done when: bump_process_counter has no definition; the reported figure equals today's on the fixtures and tests that pin it; no pin rises.
title: binaries_shared is a site count
